7. 圖中所示為 $y = -2x^2 + ax + b$ 的圖像，其中 $a$ 及 $b$ 均為常數。該圖像的對稱軸的方程為
A. $x = 2$。
B. $x = 3$。
C. $x = 5$。
D. $y = 8$。
reasoning: From the graph, the y-intercept is $(0, -10)$, so $b = -10$. One x-intercept is $(1, 0)$, so substituting into the equation: $0 = -2(1)^2 + a(1) - 10 \Rightarrow 0 = -2 + a - 10 \Rightarrow a = 12$. The equation is $y = -2x^2 + 12x - 10$. The axis of symmetry is $x = -a / (2 \cdot (-2)) = -12 / -4 = 3$.
